description:
Gate scanning (web UI + API): redemption state, duplicate detection, offline tolerance, validation of single tickets, season/park passes (multi-entry) and RFID wristbands.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Single-entry tickets redeem exactly once; passes follow their multi-entry semantics
- Gates keep scanning through connectivity loss and reconcile without double-admits
- Scan decisions return in <500ms locally with reason codes

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).
